name: GraphQL
label: GraphQL over HTTP
description: Generic GraphQL client. Sends query or mutate over HTTP (GraphQL-over-HTTP) to an operator-supplied endpoint using JDK HTTP via OfficialApiNode. Prefer a typed provider node when one exists. TLS is verified. Subscriptions over WebSocket are out of scope.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One GraphQL operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'query'.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: query | mutate. Overrides config when set.

schema.label: query
schema.description: GraphQL query or mutation document. Required. Example: query { viewer { id } }.

schema.label: variables
schema.description: GraphQL variables object. query / mutate. Example: {"id":"1"}.

schema.label: operationName
schema.description: GraphQL operationName when the document has several operations. query / mutate.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: query | mutate. Required. Example: 'query'.

configurationParameters.label: Endpoint
configurationParameters.description: Absolute GraphQL HTTP URL (https). Required. Example: 'https://api.example.com/graphql'.

configurationParameters.label: Auth Token
configurationParameters.description: Bearer token for the GraphQL host (Authorization: Bearer). Secret. Blank when the host needs no auth.

configurationParameters.label: Query
configurationParameters.description: GraphQL query or mutation document. Required. Example: query { viewer { id } }.

configurationParameters.label: Variables
configurationParameters.description: GraphQL variables object. query / mutate. Example: {"id":"1"}.

configurationParameters.label: Operationname
configurationParameters.description: GraphQL operationName when the document has several operations. query / mutate.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
